notes: The black bar at the top of videos is fixed for real this time: the last update's background cache never got its new version stamp, so phones kept serving the old shell under the old cache — this update stamps everything 1.5.2, retires the old cache, and the video layer now fills the screen edge to edge from one dedicated style that nothing else can override. Also new: every video now shows the creator's picture at the bottom left with their @handle right above the title, and a spinning disc with the creator's picture sits at the bottom right for the audio — tap it to open the sound. Scroll past the last video and you'll get a proper end-of-feed screen. Every popup with a drag line (Comments, Settings, New post, Edit profile, Audio, and the rest) can now be swiped up to expand full-screen and swiped down to close. And the Create a post button is gone from your profile page — the + tab is still the way to post. Updates are strictly manual, double-checked in this build: Reelio can never swap in a new version on its own — a new version only installs when you tap Update on the banner or Check for Updates in Settings, never in the background and never just by closing and reopening the app.
